stem: According to Newton’s first law, what happens to the steel ball just after the box stops?

options.label: F
options.text: Because of friction, the ball continues rolling forward at the same speed.

options.label: G
options.text: Because of friction, the ball rolls forward at an increased speed.

options.label: H
options.text: Because of inertia, the ball continues rolling forward at the same speed.

options.label: J
options.text: Because of inertia, the ball rolls forward at an increased speed.

visual_elements: A steel ball in a rectangular box being held by two hands, an arrow pointing forward to indicate the box moving forward
